material: MnTe, hexagonal NiAs type, P6_3/mmc (No. 194); altermagnet with T_N = 307 K

structure.cartesian_axes: x || a, z || c; a* lies in the ab plane, 30 deg from a (perpendicular to b)
structure.reciprocal_lattice_units: r.l.u. of this hexagonal cell (a* = 4 pi / (sqrt(3) a), c* = 2 pi / c)

magnetic_structure: Collinear: all Mn at z = 0 (sublattice A) parallel, all Mn at z = 1/2 (sublattice B) antiparallel to A; moments in the ab plane along an a*-type axis. The crystal has three 120-degree orientational domains and, for each, two antiphase domains with reversed Neel vector n = S_A - S_B. Field cooling through T_N changes the antiphase-domain balance.

prior_hamiltonian.source: Liu et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 156702 (2024): unpolarized inelastic neutron scattering, the Hamiltonian used for the model curves of the present data set
prior_hamiltonian.convention: H = sum over Mn pairs (each pair once) J S_i.S_j + D sum_i (S_i^z)^2, S = 5/2, J > 0 antiferromagnetic, z || c, energies in meV

shells.J_meV: average over the 12 bonds = 0.0230; how this exchange is distributed over the bonds is not fixed by the unpolarized data

hyspec.instrument: HYSPEC (SNS), time of flight, half-polarized: incident polarization P_i approximately parallel to Q (x), scattered polarization not analysed
hyspec.sample: S1, 20 K, after field cooling; crystal orientation fixed (omega = 32 deg), E_i = 37 meV
hyspec.coordinates: A slice pixel (u, v) is the wave vector Q = u (1, 0, -2.23) + v (1, 0, 1.6) in r.l.u. (scattering plane (h 0 l)). At fixed crystal orientation each pixel has a single energy transfer, given by energy_grid_meV.

energy_grid_meV.formula: E = E_i - 2.0721 |k_i - Q|^2 (meV, 1/A) with E_i = 37 meV, k_i in the (h 0 l) plane at 32 deg from a*, and the reduction lattice a = 4.100 A, c = 6.843 A

quantities.notation: I_alpha^{if}: polarization axis alpha (Blume-Maleyev: x || Q, y in the scattering plane, z = x cross y || b), incident i and scattered f spin states +, -, or 0 (not analysed)

cuts.g: symmetric, along u, integrated over v = 0.40-0.50
cuts.h: symmetric, along v, integrated over u = 0.95-1.05
cuts.i: chiral, along u, integrated over v = 0.40-0.50
cuts.j: chiral, along v, integrated over u = 0.95-1.05

hyspec.pnd: Polarized diffraction (rocking scan) at the (1 0 -1) Bragg peak in the slice frame: I_y^{+0} and I_y^{-0}. (1 0 -1) has nuclear (Te) and magnetic (Mn) contributions.

in20.instrument: IN20 (ILL) triple-axis spectrometer with Cryopad, full polarization analysis
in20.sample: S2, a different crystal; states A and B were prepared by field cooling in opposite fields
in20.pnd: Raw ILL files of rocking scans at the (1 0 1) Bragg peak in the IN20 instrument frame, the same frame as the inelastic scan files, with polarization along y and along z (non-spin-flip channels ++ and --).
in20.flipper_convention: In the raw files, I9 and I10 are the incident and scattered flipper currents: I9 > 0 selects incident spin + along P1, I10 > 0 selects scattered spin + along P2 (PX1..PZ2 give P1 and P2 in the Blume-Maleyev frame). So (I9, I10) = (+2, -2) is the channel I^{+-}.

withheld_inelastic_scans.note: Constant-energy scans at 32 meV with P1 = P2 = x, measured in channels I_x^{+-} and I_x^{-+} for states A and B. The lab does not serve them; their headers (everything above DATA_:) are given here.
